objective: Modernize the Android BUKLOD Clusters directory from oversized pastel cards and long-scrolling sections to a compact professional dashboard with accessible navigation, summary counters, local My Cluster search, expandable group list, and distinct Discover/Invites/Requests views without changing membership permissions.
productionBaselineEvidence: Owner-provided Android v28 screenshot on 2026-11-07 shows Cluster dashboard with large hero, vertically repeated Manage cards and pending/discover far below. Source inspection verified canonical /clusters route src/app/clusters/index.tsx, global bottom navigation uses /clusters and owner-scoped memory cache. Exact Production OTA/build and live device state are not verified. Changes isolated to GitHub DEV; no production publish implied.
chosenApproach: Preserve existing account-keyed cluster cache, Supabase discovery and membership mutations. Replace only dashboard presentation: compact hero and Create button; three clickable joined/invitation/pending count tiles; accessible scrollable section tabs My Clusters, Explore, Invites, Requests; fast local search and first-eight expandable list; compact white cards with separate open-workspace and admin Manage buttons, visibility labels, role/status and members; dedicated server-backed discovery search, join/approval and offline notices. Keep global bottom nav untouched.
selectionRationale: The screenshots show excessive repeated vertical height and unclear navigation across active, invited, pending and suggested groups. A section switch reduces fatigue without hiding management actions or changing privacy. Keep one canonical data source and unmodified RPCs to avoid membership regressions.
alternativeApproaches: Replace data layer with a new paginated backend RPC (rejected: backend compatibility and ownership risks for a presentation-only task).
Render all groups as large accordion cards (rejected: worsens scroll and keeps invitations/discovery buried).
Change global tab navigation instead of local segmented sections (rejected: risks Home/Wall/Connect/Profile routing and device back behavior).
preserveBehaviors: Global bottom nav Home / Cluster / Wall / Connect / Profile, Android back to Wall, active scope workspace routing and admin manage route unchanged
Only ACTIVE membership can open workspace; Manage remains admin-only, membership status and counts remain server sourced
Existing private/public badge, invitations accept/decline, pending request review wait and discover join/request-to-join preserved
User-specific session cache remains isolated by owner and offline membership fallback never authorizes online mutations
Create Cluster remains same route and no new role bypass, Supabase schema, native dependencies, Expo runtime or OTA workflow changes
First-view cluster advertising remains displayed in the same directory and no fake ad is added
Search is accessible for My Clusters locally and Explore through the existing discovery RPC
Accessibility minimum interactive touch sizes, labels, counts and disabled states are included
Production requires verified RC and exact Android OTA; PR CI does not verify actual Android device appearance
acceptanceChecks: Compact hero and Create Cluster affordance render above cluster summary counters
Joined/Invites/Pending tiles and local four-tab navigation switch the correct section
My Clusters lists active memberships, search local and show first eight with optional View all; cards still navigate and admins retain Manage
Explore searches server discovery without showing already joined/pending/invited clusters; Request to join and Join Cluster enforce online status
Invitations accept/decline via existing RPC, pending requests remain read-only
Offline and partial backend failures display saved memberships and retry, without account crossover
Global bottom navigation, first-view ad, Android back, existing cache and all other tab pages preserved
Run focused Node tests plus Engineering Accountability, TypeScript/Performance and Integration/Web compatibility on exact PR head before merging
